Class ChaosManagement

java.lang.Object
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.bootstrap.ChaosManagement
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class ChaosManagement extends Object implements AutoCloseable
The operations of the chaos management endpoints, independent of any web framework: the Spring actuator's /actuator/chaos, Micronaut's /chaos endpoint and Quarkus' /q/chaos route offer the same four.
  • snapshot — the diagnostics: every scenario with its state and counters;
  • activate — activates a plan given as JSON; the plan's handle id is plan:<name>, and a plan whose name belongs to a running plan is a conflict (every plan without a name is named default);
  • stop — stops a plan activated here, by its handle id or plan name;
  • stop all — stops every plan activated here.

Only plans activated through this instance can be stopped through it; scenarios activated by the application, a test or a startup plan are listed but left alone. Anyone who can reach an endpoint can inject faults: the endpoints are off by default and must be secured.

Agent-internal: public for the Spring Boot, Micronaut and Quarkus endpoints, which share it; not an API (configuration-reference §14.2: applications depend on ChaosPlatform only).
